set.body: Make NodeAxis wrap VertexBasis[NodeId,NodeSpec], add sameKeyOrderAs, sameKeySetAs, sameMetadataAs, and sameScientificBasisAs with explicit provenance policy. Preserve sameIdentityAs semantics temporarily, migrate call sites deliberately, and keep all Ariadne/Scala-native vectorization fixtures unchanged.
set.title: Connectivity: delegate NodeAxis to VertexBasis without compatibility drift
